description: Data files the API and the checks read at run time or build tables from. Fetch with scripts/fetch_data.py; the files themselves are gitignored and never committed. Every URL is pinned to an upstream commit and verified against sha256 before use.

data.name: disposable_email_domains
data.description: Disposable email domains, one per line (9,213 at this commit). email_address_disposable_detection checks an address's domain and each parent against it (plan C56); the API image carries it.
data.notes: Licence verified 2026-10-22: LICENSE.txt at the pinned commit is the CC0 1.0 Universal dedication. Commit of 2026-10-07 (more than 14 days old when adopted); 130,453 bytes. Upstream removed its allowlist on 2026-04-12, so operators allow domains per template (allow-domains).

data.name: libpostal_en_street_types
data.description: libpostal English street types and their abbreviations, one equivalence class per line (canonical|variant|...). Build input only: packages/checks/scripts/build-matching-data.ts folds it into packages/checks/data/matching-dictionaries.json (plan C58.2, C58.4, C58.6); never read at run time.
data.notes: Licence verified 2026-10-23: LICENSE at the pinned commit is the MIT licence, "Copyright (c) 2015 openvenues". Commit of 2025-12-06. The dictionaries README says most dictionaries were derived from token counts over OpenStreetMap names; these vocabulary files are released under the repository licence. all/given_names.txt, place_names.txt and categories (Wikipedia and OSM-wiki derived, CC BY-SA) are not used (docs/research/phase5-libraries.md section 2.3).

Build input only: packages/checks/scripts/build-matching-data.ts folds it into packages/checks/data/matching-dictionaries.json (plan C58.2, C58.4, C58.6); never read at run time.
data.notes: Licence verified 2026-10-23: LICENSE at the pinned commit is the MIT licence, "Copyright (c) 2015 openvenues". Commit of 2025-12-06. The dictionaries README says most dictionaries were derived from token counts over OpenStreetMap names; these vocabulary files are released under the repository licence. all/given_names.txt, place_names.txt and categories (Wikipedia and OSM-wiki derived, CC BY-SA) are not used (docs/research/phase5-libraries.md section 2.3).

data.description: OpenCage address-formatting subdivision codes and names per country (default and alt_<lang> names). Build input only: packages/checks/scripts/build-matching-data.ts writes packages/checks/data/subdivisions.json from it (plan C58.4); never read at run time.
data.notes: Licence verified 2026-10-23: LICENSE.txt at the pinned commit is the MIT licence, "Copyright (c) 2020 Opencage GmbH". Commit of 2026-09-03. Only conf/ is used; the repository test cases are OSM-derived and not used.

data.name: libaddressinput_countryinfo
data.description: Google libaddressinput address metadata, one data/<key>={json} line per region. Build input only: packages/checks/scripts/build-matching-data.ts takes each country's postal-code pattern (zip) and examples (zipex) into packages/checks/data/postal-codes.json (plan C58.4); never read at run time.
data.notes: Licence verified 2026-10-23: README.md at the pinned commit says "Source code licensed under the Apache 2.0. Data licensed under the CC-BY 4.0". Commit of 2026-05-15. CC BY 4.0 needs attribution: packages/checks/data/NOTICE and THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md credit Google and say the patterns were extracted and anchored.

data.name: rigour_person_names
data.description: Cross-script and spelling variant groups of person names, one group per line (157,298 groups, 569,089 forms at this commit; Wikidata items and 208 manual overrides). Build input only: packages/watchlist/scripts/build-variant-groups filters it (groups above 60 forms and scripts the matcher does not handle dropped; --hold-out <seed> for the evaluation build) into the file the worker loads (plan C78.3); the raw file is never shipped or committed.
data.notes: Licence verified 2026-10-22 (docs/research/phase6-matching.md, fact-check row 6): the repository is MIT ("Copyright (c) 2023-2025 OpenSanctions Datenbanken GmbH") at tag v2.5.0 (b0ba4ad, 2026-09-10, more than 14 days old when adopted); the groups are Wikidata Q-ids, whose structured data is CC0. 8,610,609 bytes. The groups are noisy (a group can join unrelated names), so the matcher scores a group match below an exact one (C78.4).

data.name: x4bnet_datacenter_asns
data.description: Curated ASNs of hosting and datacenter networks, one per line with a comment ('AS<n> # <organisation>'). Seed of the H-tier hosting-ASN flag (plan C92.6, C93.3), less network/asn-overrides.json; never committed or shipped, fetched into the gitignored data/.
data.notes: Licence verified 2026-10-30 (Workflow 7A Stage 1a, contracts-7a): the README declares MIT for "the scripts, automation, and the list itself" ("Copyright (c) 2024 X4B (Mathew Heard)"); the repository has no LICENSE file, so the README's MIT text is copied into THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md and re-checked whenever this pin moves (plan decision 6). Commit 30c56a5 (2026-10-15) was more than 14 days old when adopted. Duplicate ASNs are dropped by the parser (C92.6).
